_doc: SPECIAL DISTINCTION (the season manual) = the game's Brave Book 2, activity-system activity 100008 (backend_server/features/manual.py). Extracted from the running game's tables (analysis/npk/workflow_probe.json 'brave': AsActivity 100008, AsTask, AsTaskContent, AsAward). levels[i]: the training points content i of phase task 101001 needs (cumulative; the level is the highest content reached, level 1 at 0 points). level_awards[i]: [general row award, special row award] of that level. awards: states = the activity (pay) states that may claim it (none: anybody; [1, 2]: a bought distinction), props = {prop id: count} (currency props go to the wallet through currency_items, gift bags are opened into the depot, the rest goes into the depot). tasks: the pool missions: content (a contents id), exp = the training points it gives, states = pay states that may complete it. pools: daily (one new mission a day; a player keeps daily_slots of them), weekly (week_size a week in this order; a week's missions stay open all season), season (all of them all season). contents kind: login, kills, travel (meters), share, online (minutes), rank_points, game (a finished match: seconds survived at least, mode 0 any / 1 ranked, top N or 0, team 0 any 1 solo 2 duo 3 team 5 fireteam), supply (supply boxes drawn), spend (not counted), pickup (battle item picked up), use (battle item used), weapon_kills (kills with one of weapons, or with a gun listed under its type in weapon_types). strict_modes false: local battles are all solo battle-royale matches, so team and mode restrictions are not checked (else those missions could never finish). pay: the Pay screen's tasks (asRequestCompleteTask): price in currency (2 = diamonds, free first), buyable_in = the states it can be bought in, state = the activity state it sets, exp = bonus points, discount = price cut it gives other pay tasks, closes = pay tasks no longer buyable after it. change: the 'change mission' tasks (price + step per change that day, at most per_day). season: start (unix, a Monday 00:00 Manila) and days; a new season clears points, missions, claims and the distinction.
